title: Safeguarding Your Funds
section1: Ensuring the safety and security of your funds is our top priority. We understand the importance of trust and reliability in managing your financial transactions. That's why we work with regulated payment and e-money institutions to safeguard your deposits.

section2.title: Here's how it works
section2.text: When funds are posted to your account, in line with regulatory requirements, the regulated payment and e-money institutions who we work with safeguard your funds. This means that the funds shown in your payment account or e-wallet are held at reputable banks or covered by an insurance policy, and most importantly, are protected for you in the event of our partner e-money and payment institutions', or our, insolvency. Our partners stop safeguarding your funds when the money has been paid out of your account to your beneficiary's account.

section3.title: Why This Matters
section3.text: This safeguarding process ensures that your funds are always secure and available, reflecting our commitment to providing a reliable and transparent service. By working with regulated payment and e-money institutions, we adhere to the highest regulatory standards, giving you peace of mind that your money is in safe hands.

section4: If you require a breakdown of the exact amounts of funds you have safeguarded at each of our e-money and payment partners at a particular point in time, please do not hesitate to contact us.
